nodes.name: Stripe events
nodes.notes: Point a Stripe webhook endpoint here with checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded.

nodes.name: Re-fetch session
nodes.notes: The posted event is unsigned and so untrusted; only what Stripe itself returns for the session id is used.

nodes.name: Paid Braid sale
nodes.notes: Every checkout on the Stripe account reaches this endpoint. Only sessions from the Braid payment link, which carries metadata app=braid, get a licence.

nodes.name: Existing licence
nodes.notes: A Stripe retry of the same event must not mint a second key: the row for this session, if there is one, is what Build licence keeps.

nodes.name: Validate licence
nodes.notes: GET ?license=BRAID-… — the app asks once on activation and about monthly afterwards. The request carries nothing but the key.

nodes.name: Respond verdict
nodes.notes: To revoke a licence after a refund, untick `active` on its row in the braid-licenses table.
